meta.description: Review of every move shape against what the move does (2026-11-14). Four research agents compared each move description with the six drawn shapes; the reviewer then applied one rule set: beams and lasers -> fire, lightning from the sky -> gaia and from the body -> fire, cries, songs and howls -> fire (destructive sound blasts stay gaia), melee (punches, kicks, tackles, bites) -> claw, no description -> unchanged. fit: good / approximate / none; gap: the shape that is missing for approximate fits.

newShapes.note: Three shapes added for the largest gaps: melee, beam, electric. These moves moved to them.
